title_vi: 5 cách phổ biến để cải thiện hiệu năng API

source_snapshot.note: Fetched the pinned commit from GitHub; git rev-parse of the path gives the source map's blob OID. Non-empty source body read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Bộ đệm dữ liệu, cách thứ ba trong năm cách, được bàn kỹ ở bài các chiến lược bộ đệm.
Thang độ trễ giải thích vì sao mở kết nối và ghi đĩa đắt hơn đọc bộ nhớ.

claims.evidence: Statements were checked against the PostgreSQL 16 documentation (doc/src/sgml/queries.sgml on REL_16_STABLE at 8e928803020e5b5694cde58e4851fce64ef9d520), the psycopg pool documentation (docs/advanced/pool.rst at 99356800e90aa0e7b604f652d714ef0f33422b47), the Python 3.13 logging cookbook (Doc/howto/logging-cookbook.rst at 24d048d3601c2f1d41fa357897c1c91bb0a0bc13) and MDN compression (mdn/content a1aa79c09717761fc72c20bac94bb9c430ed487a), read as raw files or from a partial clone. Numbers come from an experiment run on 2026-10-18 with PostgreSQL 16.15 (Ubuntu package) on the same machine over TCP, psycopg 3.3.6 and Python 3.13.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright 1.56, headless) rendered lesson.md converted by markdown-it (CommonMark, tables, raw HTML) with a 16 px page gutter and every <details> open, at 320, 375 and 430 px: document scrollWidth equalled the viewport at each width. Smallest figure text from the SVG font sizes times the shown scale: 13.5 px at 320, 15.0 px at 375. python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser measured every figure line. Not GitHub's renderer, not a real phone, not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: Rows skipped by OFFSET still have to be computed inside the server, so a large OFFSET might be inefficient.
claims.verified_by: Read; the experiment measured OFFSET 290000 LIMIT 50 at a median of 27.7 ms against 0.231 ms for WHERE id > 290000 LIMIT 50 (same rows), and EXPLAIN ANALYZE showed an index scan over 290050 rows for the OFFSET form.

claims.claim_vi: The time to establish a new connection can be relatively long, so keeping connections open in a pool reduces latency.
claims.verified_by: Read; measured a median of 3.88 ms for connect + SELECT 1 + close against 0.106 ms for SELECT 1 on a reused connection (trust authentication, no TLS). That a PostgreSQL connection involves a handshake, authentication and a server process is the author's general knowledge.

claims.claim_vi: QueueHandler with QueueListener lets logging handlers that block do their work off the thread that logs.
claims.verified_by: Read; the caller waited a median of 273 us per line with write + fsync and 9.4 us through the queue; a child process that queued 2000 lines and exited at once left 2 lines in the file.

claims.claim_vi: Compression reduces transfer size for text such as JSON and is implemented by browsers and servers.
claims.verified_by: Read; measured 25175741 bytes of JSON for 300000 rows compressed to 3295327 bytes by gzip level 6 in 332 ms, and a 50-row page of 4191 bytes to 580 bytes.

design_notes_vi: Năm thẻ chia hai nhóm trả ít hơn và chờ ít hơn, mỗi thẻ ghi cái giá; bốn ghi chú đo thử. Không đưa chữ OFFSET viết hoa vào hình. Vẽ bằng scripts/figures.
source_deviations: Source describes pagination as streaming large result sets; the lesson covers page-based and keyset pagination and measures the deep-page cost of OFFSET.
Source presents asynchronous logging only as a gain; the lesson adds, with an experiment, that queued lines are lost when the process dies.
Source lists the five techniques without costs; the lesson groups them by what they save (bytes or waiting) and states and measures the cost of each where it could.
